items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And we had a comic on the bill at that point whose name was Don Rice.

ctx.x: house, it was built near the end of the war. And it was really a miserable week -- wierd people, and it was very difficult.

So the closing night show, we decided to really do one in. And we had a comic on the bill at that point whose name was Don Rice. And he was a comic who worked with a million props. A big arm would come out and grab him. A lot of water props. He'd pick up a phone and say Spitome and he'd get a thing of water in your kisser. Slapstick.
Well, in the closing show, it got into a water fight, which ended up that I had the fire hoses out on that stage. And I think we had to give them about $2,000 for breakage.
